title: ShieldCare Parts Share Schedule
content:
## Shares of the parts booked

The share of the parts booked on a job that a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan meets falls as the
covered item accumulates authorised repairs. The repairs authorised on the item are the claim decisions
recorded on the plan as settled by repair.

| The item's repair record | The share of the parts booked the plan meets |
| --- | --- |
| no repair stands authorised on the covered item, and at least 1 parts entry stands in the window read | the whole of the parts booked, being 100 percent |
| at least 1 repair stands authorised on the item, and the repairs authorised are no more than the plan's repair attempts figure | 90 percent of them |
| every other item | 75 percent of the parts booked |

## Both sides of the thresholds

The first row needs both limbs: with no repair authorised but no parts entry at all inside the window
read, the row is not reached. Where repairs stand authorised, the comparison is against the plan's
repair attempts figure: repairs equal to that figure are no more than it and hold the share at 90
percent, while repairs above it drop the share to 75 percent.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

On a plan whose repair attempts figure is 2, with parts of 400.00 met in the window read:

| Repairs authorised on the item | Share met | Parts met |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5 | 75 percent | 300.00 |
| 3 | 75 percent | 300.00 |
| 2 | 90 percent | 360.00 |
| 1 | 90 percent | 360.00 |
| 0 | 100 percent | 400.00 |
